name: Employment Insurance System (EIS)
description: EIS provides financial support and reemployment assistance to insured persons who lost employment.

coverage.description: All employees aged 18-60 earning up to RM4,000 per month

jobSearchAllowance.rate: 80% of average monthly wage for first 30 days, 50% thereafter

eligibility.lostEmploymentDefinition: Termination, dismissal, or end of contract (not resignation)

notes: EIS is mandatory for all employees in private sector
Contributions are capped at wage ceiling of RM4,000
Self-employed and domestic workers are not covered
